name: Girisim Elektrik Sanayi Taahhüt ve Ticaret A.S.
summary: Girisim Elektrik Sanayi Taahhüt ve Ticaret A.S. operates as an EPC company in Turkey and internationally. The company operates through Enterprise, Europower, Peak PV, EP World, Euromek, and Peakesco segments. It offers EPC services for HV and MV substations, electric distribution networks, transmission lines, thermal and hydroelectrical power plants, hydroelectric and wind power plants, geothermal and biomass power plants, combined cycle natural gas power plants, cogeneration, railways and industrial facility electrification, infrastructure and super structure projects, power factor correction, and automation and SCADA projects.
